tips.text: Live side: pull Scarlet packs one at a time, the bastion is full of patrols. Undead side: abominations hit hard.
Undead side ghouls stack disease; dispel aggressively.
Do Live side for the Scarlet quest items, Undead side for Ramstein and the Baron quests.
Run Stratholme once, both sides. Do not reset for another Baron.
At most five dungeon entries/resets per hour. Kill XP inside dungeons is increased by 50%. If any party member would get no XP because the mobs are trivial to them, nobody in the party gets XP.
Quest kill for The Archivist; it is inside the instance, so bring a full group.
